OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_DURATION_PERIOD.description: The period of time to await between two runs of the connector (ISO-8601 duration format).

CATALYST_BASE_URL.description: The base URL of the CATALYST API.

CATALYST_API_KEY.description: The CATALYST API key. If not provided, the public endpoint is used.

CATALYST_TLP_LEVEL.description: Default TLP marking applied to the imported data.

CATALYST_TLP_FILTER.description: Comma-separated list of TLP levels to fetch (options: CLEAR, GREEN, AMBER, RED, ALL).

CATALYST_CATEGORY_FILTER.description: Comma-separated list of categories to fetch (options: DISCOVERY, ATTRIBUTION, RESEARCH, FLASH_ALERT, ALL).

CATALYST_SYNC_DAYS_BACK.description: Number of days to go back when no last run is present in the connector state.

CATALYST_CREATE_OBSERVABLES.description: Whether to create observables from the fetched data.

CATALYST_CREATE_INDICATORS.description: Whether to create indicators from the fetched data.
